deals.name: Dovetail
deals.note: Built 2020-2023 inside the Pine 43 master plan; CoStar 240u vs RealPage 480u. Distinct from the proposed 270u CUP (#43).

deals.note: 270-unit CUP (two buildings, 6.28 ac C-G, height exception) inside the Pine 43 expansion approved 10/21/2025 — E Pine Ave between Locust Grove & Hickory. DISTINCT from the built Dovetail community (#15, 1350 N Webb Way) in the same master plan. Pin at the expansion annexation parcel — exact building site TBD from site plan.
